primitive_unseen_surface.role: control (a): SEEN program structure, UNSEEN wording — reference code and hidden tests byte-identical to primitive_native

exposed_native.role: anchor: composites seen in training (pipeline upper bound)

heldout_native.role: baseline: the book's failing condition (unseen composite, native unseen family prompt)

heldout_seen_surface.role: control (b): UNSEEN composite structure under a VERBATIM training surface frame — ref code + tests identical to heldout_native

new_composite_unseen_surface.role: control (c): NEW length-matched composite, novel wording — 2x2 cell unseen structure x unseen surface

new_composite_seen_surface.role: control (c)+(b): NEW length-matched composite under a VERBATIM training frame — 2x2 cell unseen structure x seen surface
